artifacts.notes: Two pages only: parent PDF page 248 (columns 1509-1510), carrying Augustine, Enarratio in Psalmum CXVIII, the end of sermo III and sermo IV sections 1-3 on verses 4-6; and parent PDF page 431 (columns 1875-1876), carrying Enarratio in Psalmum CXLIV sections 9-11 on verses 7-8. The second page has heavy show-through but is legible. The pages were located by column arithmetic from the registered Psalm 88 segment (PDF page 63 = columns 1139-1140). All other parent pages are omitted; the parent stays remote for its measured size.
artifacts.rights_basis: The 1845 Paris printing is in the public domain in the United States: the repository's own rights reading, recorded at guidance/missals.md section 5, is that a work first published abroad before 1931 is in the public domain with no term running. The scan is a Google digitization delivered by the Internet Archive. A mechanical digitization of a public-domain printing adds no original authorship of its own. No modern editorial text is added by this retention.

artifacts.notes: Internet Archive OCR was used only to navigate to the page image. The verified passage wording rests on direct inspection of the facsimile.
